transcript: My dad collapsed and isn't breathing

Call 999 now (112 from a mobile phone).

Level 1 - Resuscitation
Level 1 - Resuscitation (target time to treatment: immediate). Call 999 now (112 from a mobile phone). This needs emergency care right away.

Immediate steps (do these now):
- If the person is unresponsive and not breathing normally, start chest compressions at once: place your hands in the centre of the chest and push hard and fast (about 100–120 compressions per minute). Continue without long pauses.
- If you are trained in CPR, give rescue breaths in the accepted ratio after compressions; if not trained, continue continuous compressions until help arrives.
- Send someone to get an AED (defibrillator) and use it as soon as it is available; follow the device prompts.
- Keep doing CPR and follow the ambulance dispatcher’s instructions until emergency services arrive.
